articles.summary: PR Newswire: Transit Technologies Appoints Srithal Bellary as Chief Technology, Data & AI Officer to Lead AI-First Platform Transformation. Transit Technologies, a leading provider of software solutions for modern transit systems, today announced the appointment of Srithal Bellary as its Chief Technology, Data & AI Officer.
